list.$description: List: the options of a drop-down, a combo box or a list box.

container.$description: The list: its space around and between the items, its height before it scrolls, and a surface a design may give it.

group.$description: The items under one header (the same space between them as in the list).

item.$description: An option: under the pointer, pressed, the one the keys are on (`active`), chosen (`selected`), disabled; `next`: an item after another (a line between them), `select-all`: the "Select all" row.

indicator.$description: The bar on a chosen item, centred along its side (`margin-start` / `margin-end`: `auto` on one side puts it on the other); `multiple`: in a list of several choices.

check.$description: Where the mark of a chosen item stands in a list of several choices (a box a design may draw).

mark.$description: The mark of a chosen item in a list of several choices.

header.$description: A group's header (as high as an item: a long list counts rows of one height).

select-all-divider.$description: The line under "Select all", drawn over the row so every row keeps one height.
